core_finding: Phase O did not own a standalone exit policy. It inherited the composite AEGIS_TURBO TypeScript policy: exchange-native initial brackets, break-even and trailing management, ExitEye profit protection or profitable signal exit, and a conditional eight-hour time exit.

risk_unit.ambiguity: D1A does not bind a Phase O leverage to each E3 entry, while historical Phase O could execute at multiple leverage tiers.

blocking_elements_for_exact_d1a_replay: per-entry Phase O leverage is not present in the D1A trajectory artifact
ATR(14) requires pre-entry candles not contained in the 12-bar D1A trajectory rows
ExitEye requires contemporaneous model actions and votes that D1A did not freeze
five-minute OHLC cannot recover exchange event order when bracket or moved-stop events share a candle
the historical conditional timeout is eight hours, while D1A trajectories stop at H12/60 minutes
